columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_TASK_ID
columns.description: System generated unique identifier to represent a row.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: PARENT_TASK_ID
columns.description: Parent Task Id (in Hierarchical case).

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_RECORD_ID
columns.description: Assignment Record Id (referential key from assignment records table).

columns.name: TASK_OWNER_ID
columns.description: Who is responsible to finish the task , mostly PERSON_ID, could be learner, learner manger,Learn Admin, AOR id, or any other groups that is maintained.

columns.name: TASK_OWNER_TYPE
columns.description: ORA_PERSON ( most of the time it is PERSON), could be SYSTEM if you want to track Notification generation as well. Could be Areas of Responsibility, Access group.

columns.name: LEARNING_ITEM_ID
columns.description: What learning item needs to be acted on , for example classId(class learning item id) in class preferences use case.

columns.name: TASK_STATUS
columns.description: Stores status of the task.

columns.name: ACCESS_ALLOWED_ON_DATE
columns.description: The date on which assignment task access has been given to the learner

columns.name: COMPLETION_DATE
columns.description: Completion date of the task.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: To track the source of the record creation for this table , similar to assignment records table.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: To track the source of the record creation for this table , similar to assignment records table.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: To track the source of the record creation for this table , similar to assignment records table.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: IS_OPEN
columns.description: Column value represent whether activity is open for learner to start or not.

columns.name: SECTION_LI_ID
columns.description: Column value represents section learning item id of the activity

columns.name: LEARNING_ITEM_TYPE
columns.description: Column value represent learning item type of activity

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: NOTES
columns.description: Notes by the admin for a learner activity task

columns.name: SCORE
columns.description: Score acheived by  a learner activity task

columns.name: EFFORT
columns.description: ACTUAL EFFORT learner has spent on a activity task

columns.name: EFFORT_UOM
columns.description: Unit of measure for effort

columns.name: TASK_SUB_STATUS
columns.description: Substatus of the task.

columns.name: TRAINING_EFFORT
columns.description: TRAINING EFFORT learner has spent on a activity task

columns.name: REASON_CODE
columns.description: Reason for completion

columns.name: VILT_URL
columns.description: Learner vilt URL

columns.name: VILT_CALL_TIME
columns.description: VILT Call time

columns.name: VILT_CALL_STATUS
columns.description: VILT call status

columns.name: VILT_CALL_LOG
columns.description: VILT call log

columns.name: EXEMPTED_ON_DATE
columns.description: Date on which exemption given for this Task or Activity

columns.name: REQ_ACT_COMPLETION_COUNT
columns.description: Represent the count of activities required to complete section.

columns.name: COMPLETED_ACTIVITY_COUNT
columns.description: Represents the activities that are completed for this section.

columns.name: REQUIRED_PREDECESSOR
columns.description: A predecessor task that needs to be completed for learner to access current task.

columns.name: TASK_COMPLETION_RULE
columns.description: Represents whether current task is required or optional to complete the section

columns.name: TASK_POSITION
columns.description: Represents the activity or section position  in catalog definition

columns.name: LI_DEF_USED_DATE
columns.description: Represents the timestamp of the learning item change used for this assignment task creation/update

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Represents the start date of activity attempt

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_TASK_NUMBER
columns.description: UserKey to uniquely identify assignment task

columns.name: ACTIVITY_DEFINITION
columns.description: Represents activity definition object.

columns.name: EXPIRATION_DATE
columns.description: The date that the assignment will expire.

columns.name: TASK_TYPE
columns.description: Represents type of task related to Example task is created for Rating activity  or Evaluation activity.
